Definition: from G5319; exhibition, i.e. (figuratively) expression, (by extension) a bestowment:--manifestation.
BiblicalUsage: Phanerosis is manifestation, exhibition, the showing forth of something, and it appears twice, both times about what God shows through His people. The manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal, and Paul says he has renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, commending himself to every man's conscience by manifestation of the truth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe manifestation is how the Spirit works in the church: not hidden in one gifted person but shown through every believer for the good of all. And I hold that the truth commends itself the same way, openly, with nothing hidden and nothing to be ashamed of.
